title: Aflatoon
desc: A narrative unfolding the tale of two brothers residing far from their home, eager to dispatch a sweet treat to their unwell father.

title: Ansh
desc: When Nidhi visits an orphanage with hopes of adopting, she is confronted by the unresolved trauma of losing her own child to kidnapping. As she battles grief and depression, she must find a way to heal and embrace life again. A poignant tale of loss, resilience, and the power of hope.

title: Akhiri Parchi
desc: This movie serves as an inspirational tool for kids, helping them grasp the extent of their parents' sacrifices and efforts to ensure their lives are comfortable and fulfilling, despite challenging circumstances. It aims to convey a powerful message, encouraging children to maximize their available resources and strive for their best.

title: Abba Ki Chaddi
desc: in Small town where she lives.. Whose husband used to bother her a lot and was responsible for everything, One day suddenly her husband starts fearing her in the name of his father's stick.she does not like his words,makes

title: Baggage
desc: The film is about Sara’s journey as she goes about understanding her role in the greater scheme of things. Sara - who has lost her twin sister to a mysterious vanishing - is trying to come to grips with her loss.

title: Barat
desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

title: Antahakaran
desc: As a devout Hindu seeks vengeance, his two associates with conflicting ideologies attempt to manipulate him.

title: A Notice
desc: Notice is a Hindi short film about a couple and the distance which gets created due a loss, it is about the unsaid things in a relationships.

title: A Tale Of An Onion Witch Chapter 2
desc: One year after the mysterious events of part 1, a newly married couple comes across a lady who claims to be Mangla. They are warned about the 150-year-old Witch that wanders around at night asking for an Onion. Things go haywire when a small girl knocks for help at midnight.

title: Adhure Poore Se Hum
desc: Two college time friends embark on a long drive on a Sunday morning, leaving their bustling city lives behind. As they amble through the hilly roads, they reveal to each other, their old longings and hidden pasts. Their rose tinted nostalgia is broken and they come face to face with their imperfect lives.

title: Aam Ka Achaar
desc: Haunted by the riots that took his parents 20 years ago, Karan confronts the man who once loved him as a son—yet betrayed him in the worst way. Torn between revenge and forgiveness, he seeks meaning in the madness. A powerful story of loss, betrayal, and the fight for redemption.

title: Be Khush
desc: Be Khush' is a satire and commentary on commercialism and the society we live in. In a dystopian world, where happiness is scarce and nobody is happy, comes 'Be Khush'. A pill which can provide you happiness on any occasion. But what happens, when someone starts giving away happiness for free?

title: An Astrologer's Day
desc: Based on a short story by R.K. Narayan from Malgudi Days. A normal day in the life of an astrologer reveals a lot about him.

title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

title: Ahsaas
desc: Ahsaas is the emotional journey of Sana, a devoted wife caught in society’s definition of a “complete woman.” As childlessness becomes a burden, her husband’s support becomes her strength—leading them to seek help and reclaim their peace, together.

title: Arundeep Singh
desc: A man with a speech disorder who even struggles to do his day to day activities will face his greatest fear of dating a woman.

title: Family
desc: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

title: Bahar Aa Chaman Prakash
desc: Bahar Aa Chaman Prakash" delves into the story of a man reluctant to marry his lifelong acquaintance. Shutting himself away and avoiding his father, he faces the girl his father wishes him to wed. When she joins him and locks themselves in a room, they emerge with a revelation connected to the man's inner struggles. Will his father embrace this truth?

title: Alvida
desc: Break-ups can be hard, but sometimes they are necessary. Sometimes, you need all your strength to let go and say ... Alvida.

title: ABC
desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

title: Agarbatti
desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

title: Live A Little
desc: It starts with an after-party sequence. It is late at night. Nimisha, 26, struggles to get a ride back home when Atish, 46, sees this and offers her help. She refuses at first but eventually agrees. The journey gives Nimisha a peek into her boss's life. As they reach Nimisha’s destination they are ready to move on in their lives, but the night has more to offer them. Due to a sudden turn of events, they end up under one roof and despite their differences, they help each other get a new perspective
